title: Remote proxy sessions and check overlap: when a proxy may stop counting as an overlapping writer, and a transient-write control for focused checks
outcome: It is decided, with evidence, under which identity and coverage conditions a remote proxy session may stop counting as a writer that overlaps a check: a distinct backend on the same machine, a same-process loopback, a genuinely remote equal path, or network-shared storage. Focused checks gain a control against transient writes, because today they get no watcher fence. Until then, proxies keep counting conservatively.
acceptance: Remote proxy sessions and check overlap: when a proxy may stop counting as an overlapping writer, and a transient-write control for focused checks is done
